terms.label: Licence replacement (renewal) application has been submitted
terms.definition: The person has submitted (or is hereby submitting) an application for replacement of the driving licence to the Transport Administration.

anchors.quote: Provisional driving licences and driving licences are issued within ten working days as of the day after which the respective test was passed or an application for replacement of the driving licence was submitted.

terms.label: Valid medical certificate on record
terms.definition: A currently valid medical certificate has been issued for the person, delivered via the health information system or submitted to the Transport Administration.

anchors.quote: Compliance with the medical requirements is proven by a medical certificate issued by the person who carried out the medical examination.
anchors.note: Compliance must be proven, not asserted.

anchors.quote: ... where no new valid medical certificate has been issued to the driver via the health information system or the driver fails to submit a new valid medical certificate to the Transport Administration by the due date at the latest.
anchors.note: The law itself names the register: the health information system is the electronic channel for the certificate.

terms.label: State fee has been paid
terms.definition: The state fee for issuing or replacing the driving licence has been paid.

anchors.quote: A state fee is payable for issuing or replacing a driving licence.
anchors.note: Amount set by the State Fees Act.

terms.label: Right to drive is suspended or withdrawn
terms.definition: The person's right to drive has been suspended or withdrawn (§ 125); established by the data of the motor register.

anchors.quote: A provisional driving licence and a driving licences is not issued to a person whom no right to driver has been granted or whose right to drive has been suspended or withdrawn in accordance with § 125 of this Act ...
anchors.note: Deny condition. (Grammar as in the official translation.)

anchors.quote: The right to drive a motor vehicle is proven based on the data of the motor register.
anchors.note: The motor register is the authoritative source for the right to drive.

provenance.notes: Teaching example authored 2026-09-02; anchored to the official English translation of the Road Traffic Act (Estonian consolidated text RT I, 11.07.2026, 44 prevails).
